name: webconsulting/flue
description: TYPO3 control plane for the Flue agent framework - define/trigger durable AI flows, inject page context, export skillflow skills, mirror runs, all driven from a backend module.

suggest.webconsulting/skillflow: Exports skills (SKILL.md) to the Flue sidecar and shares the {uid} context resolver.
suggest.hn/typo3-mcp-server: Exposes TYPO3 as MCP tools that Flue agents consume (PAT via OAuthService::createDirectAccessToken).
suggest.netresearch/nr-vault: Stores the LLM API key; the trigger service injects it per request, never on disk.
